## Summary

One-paragraph description of what this PR changes and why.

## Spec

- Link to the spec doc this PR implements (`docs/specs/PR-NNN-*.md`),
  or "N/A" with a one-sentence justification if there's no spec yet.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each numbered criterion in the spec is addressed (link spec section).
- [ ] CI green: lint, typecheck, unit tests, build, e2e.

## Screenshots / recordings

- For UI changes, include before/after for both light and dark mode.
- For server-only changes, an `httptie`/`curl` transcript is fine.

## Tests

- [ ] Unit tests added for new logic.
- [ ] Component tests added for new UI.
- [ ] E2E updated if a new user-visible flow was added.
- [ ] axe-core assertion added to any new component test.

## Docs

- [ ] `docs/NN-*.md` updated if implementation diverges from a doc
  (per the rule in CLAUDE.md).
- [ ] CLAUDE.md docs index updated if a new top-level doc was added.

## Notes for the reviewer

- Risky areas, places I'd particularly like another set of eyes on,
  follow-up issues / future PRs spawned by this one.
